title: Alien dictionary order
statementMd:
Words are sorted in an unknown alphabet. Derive a letter order: add an edge from the first differing letters of each adjacent word pair, then topologically sort using the smallest available letter first. Return the string, or `""` if there is a contradiction (cycle) or an invalid prefix order (`"abc"` before `"ab"`).

**Example:** `alien_order(["wrt", "wrf", "er", "ett", "rftt"])` returns `"wertf"`.
hints: Build the graph, then Kahn with a heap.
